title: SiteForge tool output, version 1
description: What a crawler or migration tool such as Smartcite reports for one website, so SiteForge can score it against the private answer key with `node src/cli.mjs evaluate --truth <site>/private/answer-key.json --actual <this file> --out <dir>`. Only url and cluster are required per page; every other part is scored when present and reported as unavailable when absent. Cluster labels are free text: scoring compares which pages share a label, not the label itself.

tool.description: Optional name and version of the tool that produced the output. Not scored.

schemas.description: Optional: the field names the tool found for each content type.

url.description: Absolute, or relative to the site's address. Fragments are ignored; query strings count.

cluster.description: The tool's group label for pages with the same data structure.

contentType.description: Optional content type name; map tool names to SiteForge names with the evaluator's contentTypeMap option.

fields.description: Optional field name to extracted text. Names can be mapped with fieldNameMap. Values are compared after Unicode NFC, trimming and whitespace collapsing.

relationships.description: Optional links between records, such as a book's author page.

repeatedItems.description: Optional, added 2026-11-02: records listed on a listing page (cards, table rows). Each is matched to the answer key by url when given, otherwise by position.

url.description: The record's own page, if the listing links to it.
